# Panter, Panter & Sampedro

> Florida-based personal injury law firm specializing in accident litigation, premises liability, and negligence cases across Miami and South Florida.

Panter, Panter & Sampedro is a family-owned Miami law firm offering comprehensive personal injury legal services. The firm handles a wide range of accident cases including transportation accidents, premises liability claims, and specialized injury matters, with a focus on aggressive representation and client consultation.
